### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8f36f6b0604123f328841138448b375ebc2af946` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8f4d9c61b98b1a7a09cd139bd23b6d57759534af`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/core/src/utils/kanban-declared-lanes.ts, ui/packages/core/src/index.ts, ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx (the `case 'kanban'` branch and the import line), ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx (`generateViewSchema`'s `case 'kanban'` and its memo deps), packages/spec/liveness/view.json (the `kanban` row), the four new tests, .changeset/28211-kanban-declared-lanes.md + ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx (`effectiveColumns`, `pagedLaneIdsKey`, the lane queries), ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanLanePaging.ts (`uncolumnedQueryFilter`), ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts (`KanbanConfigSchema.lanes`), ui/packages/types (the `object-kanban` `columns` shape)

Inputs: card #28211 (body and all five comments: triage 6530215469 with its one-file cross-domain exception, the seat's claim 6537960788, amendment 6537973671 which moves the surface from `ObjectKanban` to the two producers plus one core helper, the dev report 6538446315, amendment 2 6538460840 which flips Clause-② to widening and routes the PR here), PR #28291 (body, the one docs-drift comment, the file list of 10 files, the diff of 644 lines against `main` read whole, the three commits from merge-base 8f36f6b0), the 69 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T04:01Z: all 69 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Auto Label, Build Docs, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), UI Published Artifacts), and the tree at this head for every claim the body makes about the board. The head is mergeable and clean against today's `main` (merge-tree clean; `ListView.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx` and `ObjectKanban.tsx` are untouched on `main` since the merge-base, so the #25918 overlap the body names has not arrived).

### ① Derived judgments

- **The card's effect, by the amended mechanism** - right. `ObjectKanban` never receives `kanban.lanes`: both producers forward named block keys only, and the `object-kanban` node declares `columns` (its lanes, `{ id, title, collapsed? }`) but no `lanes`. The helper `kanbanDeclaredLanes(lanes, options)` maps the declared list onto `columns` in the author's order, titles each lane from its option's label (the value itself until the definition loads), marks a `kind: 'lost'` option `collapsed: true`, and returns `undefined` for no or empty `lanes`, so a view without the key builds the node it built before (pinned by both producers' CONTROL cases). `ListView` reads `lanes` off the block beside `columns`, `titleField` and `summarizeField` and spreads `columns` only when lanes exist; `ObjectView#generateViewSchema` does the same from `kanbanCfg.lanes` and adds `objectSchema` to its memo deps so titles follow the definition once it lands (`ListView`'s memo already depends on `objectDef`).
- **The board honours explicit columns as given** - right. `effectiveColumns` (ObjectKanban.tsx:1453) returns object-shaped `schema.columns` through `localizeColumn` only, so the author's order stands and a translated label still wins; the lifecycle ordering (`lanesFromOptions`, #26612) applies only to lanes derived from options, which is the branch declared lanes bypass, and the helper carries the lost-lane collapse across instead. Pinned on the real board (ObjectKanban.declaredLanes-28211.test.tsx rows a and c).
- **Nothing is hidden** - right, on both data paths. When lanes page on their own, `pagedLaneIdsKey` (:717) reads object-shaped `schema.columns` ids first and the uncolumned query is `uncolumnedQueryFilter` (KanbanLanePaging.ts:106): base AND (`laneField nin laneIds` OR `is_null`), so every unlisted value is fetched into `Uncategorized`. When loaded rows are bucketed client-side, a value matching no column lands in the `Uncategorized` lane as before; pinned on the real board with a record whose value is unlisted (row b). Membership and repeats are judged at authoring (`list-view-kanban-lane-unknown` / `-repeated`, #28196), so the renderer rightly takes the list as declared.
- **Accept-set: nothing an author writes moves** - right. No spec schema changes; `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` changes only the `kanban` row's note, moving `lanes` from planned to live and citing both producers, the helper and the board's `effectiveColumns` by path and symbol, which is what the card asked and what the triage exception allows. `check:liveness` is the gate for that note's shape.
- **Public surface** - `@object-ui/core` gains `kanbanDeclaredLanes` and the types `KanbanLaneOption`, `KanbanDeclaredLane` on the barrel; nothing else. The seat's amendment 2 records the widening.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every run on this head completed and none is red, cancelled or in progress at the read.

### ② Semver level

- **`@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-view`, `@objectstack/spec` all patch; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; `Metadata-protocol: none`** - accepted. The core export is additive and the two producers change behaviour only when a key that was declared-but-inert is present; the spec entry covers a liveness note, not a published type or schema, so patch is the most it could be. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no key, value or default an author writes moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Stale spec text, named for a follow-up and not this PR's** - the TSDoc on `KanbanConfigSchema.lanes` (view.zod.ts:2096, "Lands ahead of its reader: the board draws one lane per option until the console half reads this key") becomes false when this lands, and rider S2 (the `checkKanbanLanes` docblock in `packages/lint`) is outside the liveness file. Both are spec-source edits outside the triage exception; the seat's amendment 1 and the PR body commit to filing them as one `domain:spec` follow-up after merge. The seat files that card when this lands.
- **Rider S1** (an author of `lanes` gets no "declared, not yet drawn" word) closes by the flip to live, as the card said.
- **Serial overlap** - the one hunk outside `case 'kanban'` is the `@object-ui/core` import line in `ListView.tsx`; #25918 has not landed on `main`, so no merge is owed now; if it lands first, the seat merges `main` and the lane re-claims with a delta.
- **No name approval owed** - the key `lanes` was ruled with #28196; the helper's name is a ui internal.

### ④ Design judgment

- **Nothing blocking, and no should-fix on the diff.** Tried: a lane value the options do not describe (titled with the value, re-titled when the definition loads, because both producers' memos depend on the definition); numeric option values (`String()` on both sides of the map, and the board compares lane ids as strings); explicit lanes with lane paging on (declared ids drive the per-lane queries and the uncolumned query is the complement); a listed lost lane (collapsed via the node's own `collapsed`, pinned); an empty `lanes` array (treated as undeclared, pinned). The mapping lives in one function both producers call, which is the right place for a rule two routes must agree on.

**Verdict reasoning.** The PR delivers the card's effect through the mechanism the seat amended before any edit, with `ObjectKanban` unchanged and the board's existing `columns` contract doing the work; the author's order wins, nothing is hidden on either data path, a view without `lanes` is byte-for-byte the same node, and each claim is pinned on the real board or the real producer with an ablation shown red. The liveness note is the one cross-domain edit triage allowed; semver is patch everywhere with the widening declared. The stale spec TSDoc is a named follow-up outside this card's surface.

Its boundary flag is the stale `KanbanConfigSchema.lanes` TSDoc plus rider S2. The seat files both as one `domain:spec` follow-up when this lands.
4. **Gates / check-runs:** on `8f4d9c61`, 69 runs: all completed, 0 failure, including `Spec property liveness` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` via Build. `mergeable_state` clean. Dev's local run: 66 of 67 derived gates green, and the one not measured locally is covered by CI.
5. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 28291` reports NOT governed, 517 changed lines ≤ 3000. The seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge, on the maintainer's 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (seat thread, 2026-10-30T14:19Z).
